missing_evidence: Redis server latency/saturation metrics for the incident window
Inventory service logs around the timeout window
candidates.statement: Redis reserve_inventory operations time out (~2s) on the inventory service, causing inventory POST /v1/reservations to return 503 and propagating ReadTimeout 502s up through order and gateway checkout.
candidates.uncertainty: No Redis-side metrics or logs confirm the underlying cause of the timeouts (saturation, latency, or connectivity).

report.explanation: Traces show redis.reserve_inventory timing out with DependencyUnavailable, inventory returning 503, and order/gateway returning 502 ReadTimeout; gateway metrics show elevated checkout p95 (~2.4s) and 502s. Topology confirms gateway->order->inventory->redis path. Bounded to redis-timeout; underlying Redis cause unconfirmed.
